The Petitioner is aged about 44 years, Respondent No.2 is aged about 25 years.

Respondent No.2, in her written complaint running into approximately two and a half pages, has alleged that about five years prior, the Petitioner took her to Tiruvannamalai on the occasion of Karthika Pournami for the purpose of performing sacred pradakshinas around the hill.
It is alleged that during this visit, the Petitioner administered juice laced with a sedative substance to Respondent No.2 and thereafter committed sexual intercourse with her against her will.
It is further alleged that subsequent to the said incident, the Petitioner continued to have sexual relations with Respondent No.2 on several occasions at different places.
The complaint states that both of them resided together in a rented room at Bangalore for a period of two months, during which the Petitioner repeatedly engaged in sexual intercourse with her.

Respondent No.2 has further alleged that the Petitioner insisted upon her providing a dowry of Rs.10,00,000/- along with fifty sovereigns of gold ornaments as a precondition for solemnizing marriage with her.
Subsequently, as the Petitioner failed to fulfil his promise of marriage and his mother gave evasive replies regarding the proposed marriage.
